children: Perspective announced a clinical collaboration with Merck to evaluate [212Pb]PSV359 combined with Keytruda in FAP-α positive solid tumors.
Perspective entered a clinical collaboration and supply agreement with Merck to study [212Pb]PSV359 plus pembrolizumab.
The combination will be evaluated via an amendment to Perspective’s ongoing Phase 1/2a study in FAP-α positive NSCLC and colorectal cancer (NCT06710756).
Study has completed enrollment in the first three monotherapy dose cohorts; Perspective remains the study sponsor.
Merck will provide pembrolizumab at no cost, supporting the combination evaluation without added drug expense to the trial.
